channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: MCASD CEO Kathryn Kanjo leaving to head UC Irvine museum expansion
item.description: Kathryn Kanjo, a 15-year veteran of The Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego, is leaving her position as CEO to head UC Irvine's growing museum operations.

item.title: Point Loma coach, player receive local awards
item.description: Ryan Price, in his second year at the helm of the Pointer program, was recognized as the prep "Coach of the Year."

item.title: USA Freestyle Martial Arts in Point Loma earns a world championship
item.description: Point Loma has a new addition to its growing number of successful sports franchises: a karate team celebrating a world championship.

item.title: March in La Jolla brings ‘people first’ message to billionaires
item.description: Marchers denounced the "billionaires first" agenda of crackdowns on free speech, attacks on immigrants, and workers' rights, and more.

item.title: Council approves $30 million settlement in fatal police shooting of Konoa Wilson, 16
item.description: Konoa died Jan. 28 when a police officer shot him while he fled from another person who fired shots at him at the Santa Fe Depot.

item.title: 10 can’t-miss concerts this week: San Diego’s best musicians celebrate the holidays
item.description: Blues guitarist Johnny Vernazza celebrates the release of his new album, “Home by Christmas,” with a special event at Humphreys Backstage Live on Dec. 17.

item.title: Supervisors call on county to work with state in fight against offshore drilling in San Diego
item.description: County supervisors voted 4-1 Tuesday to pass a resolution opposing the Trump administration’s plans to reopen California to offshore oil drilling.

item.title: Supervisors OK proposal to move San Onofre nuclear waste from coastline
item.description: The San Diego County Board of Supervisors Tuesday unanimously approved a proposal to pursue partnerships with national laboratories on resolving issues with spent nuclear fuel stored at the closed San Onofre plant.

item.title: Opinion: A water district using its own water shouldn’t be controversial
item.description: The Sweetwater Authority opens Loveland Reservoir as a recreational destination, but we still must make annual transfers to serve our communities.

item.title: City Council backs SDPD surveillance policies despite opposition
item.description: After nearly six hours of public comment and council discussion, the San Diego City Council voted Tuesday night to approve the continued use of 54 surveillance use policies by the San Diego Police Department.
